onceUponTime: Once upon a time, there was a beautiful girl who lived with her father and her stepmother and stepsisters.
fatherPassedAway: One day, her father sadly passed away, leaving her heartbroken at the mercy of the woman her father had remarried.
personalMaid: She became their personal maid. She was made to cook, clean, and take care of the house, while they laughed at her and ridiculed her.
mercyOfHint: Under the power of her stepmom
cinderellaEscapes: Cinderella decides to escape, run away from everyone and everything.
stumblesMonastery: She stumbles across a monastery, and she decides to join the nuns there, going on to live a peaceful life surrounded by kind women.
endingRanAway: Ending: Ran away. Press (R) to restart the game!
fallDeafEars: Sadly, she knew that any complaints would fall on deaf ears.
workedDiligently: She worked diligently, no matter how sad she felt about her situation.
hopedBetter: She hoped that one day things would get better.
ballLeftBehind: One night, Cinderella’s stepmother and stepsisters left her behind to tend to the house as they went to a ball to try to meet the prince.
disappointedWantedGo: Cinderella was disappointed, because she had also wanted to go, but she continued cleaning, without complaining.
fairyAppeared: That’s when, out of nowhere, a fairy appeared! She said she was Cinderella’s godmother, and that she would help her get ready for the ball.
leftBehindHint: Didn't take her to the ball
fairyRespects: The fairy respects her wishes and leaves. Cinderella continues to scrub the dirty floors.
spendsLife: She spends her life taking care of her stepsisters and their offspring
diesAlone: She dies alone, her family too busy to visit her.
endingDiedAlone: Ending: Died alone. Press (R) to restart the game!
promiseLove: “I promise you’ll love your new look!” The fairy’s excitement is contagious, and Cinderella ended up accepting her offer.
abracadabra: “Abracadabra!” and with a flick of her wand, the fairy transformed Cinderella’s raggedy clothes into a beautiful gown.
beamedThanked: Cinderella beamed and thanked her godmother.
pleasureDarling: “It’s my pleasure, darling! Just remember, all the magic will fade at midnight, so make sure to be back by then!”
leftCarriage: And so, Cinderella left in a magical carriage, into a night she would never forget.
contagiousHint: It made Cinderella feel excited too
carriageHint: A classical vehicle pulled by a horse
arrivedBall: Cinderella arrived at the ball, and everyone turned to look at her. Her family didn’t recognize her, because they had never seen her dolled up.
princeAwestruck: The prince was awestruck by Cinderella’s beauty, and he asked her to dance, while her jealous stepsisters watched.
stolenHeart: Cinderella and the prince danced together for hours. She had stolen his heart. He asked her to come back to the palace with him, but just as he did, the clock struck midnight.
dolledUpHint: Dressed in fancy or formal clothing
stolenHeartHint: He fell in love with her
tellSeeAgain: Tell him she will see him again
dressConverts: Cinderella’s dress converts back to the rags that she was dressed in before the dance.
prohibitedCastle: Since the usage of magic is prohibited in the castle,. the prince orders her to be locked up in the dungeon.
endingLockedAway: Ending: Locked away... Press (R) to restart the game!
forgottenShoe: She ran back to her carriage and arrived home just in time. However, in her rush, she didn’t realize she had forgotten her shoe.
searchingOwner: The prince went all over the kingdom searching for the shoe owner, hoping to find the girl who he had fallen in love with the night of the ball.
foundMarried: When he found her at last, and despite her stepsisters’ complaints, he married her and they lived happily ever after.
endingHappilyEver: Ending: Happily Ever After... Press (R) to restart the game!
rushHint: To have to go somewhere quickly
happilyEverHint: Happy for the rest of their lives
quizFallDeafEars: What does the expression 'fall on deaf ears' mean?
reasonFigurative: It's a figurative expression, not literal.
reasonPaidAttention: 'Fall on deaf ears' means nobody paid attention to her.
reasonAudienceNotListening: The phrase is about the audience not listening, not the explanation.
quizMercyStepmother: What does 'at the mercy of her stepmother' mean?
ansStepmotherPowerful: Her stepmother is more powerful than her.
reasonDependsStronger: Being 'at the mercy' means she depends on someone stronger.
ansStepmotherBeautiful: Her stepmother is more beautiful than her.
reasonRefersControl: 'At the mercy' refers to power or control, not beauty.
ansStepmotherWeaker: Her stepmother is weaker than her.
reasonOppositeStronger: It's the opposite—the stepmother is stronger.
quizRidiculed: What did they do to Cinderella when they 'ridiculed' her?
reasonMocking: Ridiculing means mocking or making fun of her.
ansMockedHer: They mocked or made fun of her
reasonRidiculeMock: 'Ridicule' someone is to mock them or make fun of them.
quizClothingBefore: What did Cinderella’s clothing look like before the fairy transformed her?
quizBeamedGodmother: What did Cinderella do when she “Beamed” at her godmother?
quizWand: What did the fairy godmother do with her wand?
quizRush: Why was the princess in a rush?
ansSpellWearOff: The spell would wear off soon
